blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Люди называют ___ (эта птица) кукушкой.
exercises.prompt: People call this kind of bird a cuckoo.
exercises.why: The direct object of «называть»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom used a crowbar to pry open the lid of the crate.
exercises.ru: Том использовал лом, чтобы открыть ___ ящика.
exercises.why: The direct object of «открыть»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том очистил ___ (рыба) от чешуи.
exercises.prompt: Tom scraped the scales off the fish.
exercises.why: The direct object of «очистить»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom caught a pike that was sixty centimetres long.
exercises.ru: Том поймал ___ длиной в шестьдесят сантиметров.
exercises.why: The direct object of «поймать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он подстрекал ___ (невинный юноша) к участию в своей грязной сделке.
exercises.prompt: He was egging an innocent young man on to join him in his crooked deal.
exercises.why: The direct object of «подстрекать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The direct object of «обнаружить»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The direct object of «защищать»: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
